text:
Blood in the streets (visualized)

"Not only is this his magnum opus," says Buffett, "but I've always found that when I'm moving up the cap stack, Carter II is my go-to album."

"Weezy just makes me want to go out and prime someone for the fuck of it, dilute them, cram them down, bagel their equity, and ensure that not a cent of recovery value is left for any claims junior to Berkshire. Then, I mail them a handwritten note, on Berkshire stationary, that simply says: this is the carter."

"Did I need 10% perpetual from Goldman, no, I would've taken 8%. But as soon as Hustler Musik came on, I knew I had to arb every last penny from this decaying squid enterprise."

"If I had taken one more penny, they would've gone under. That's how bad I scraped them. I left those clowns with just one stapler, one, and I took all the staples out of it just to fuck with Lloyd. I stole all his toilet paper and replaced it with shares of GS common stock, the certificates, just to remind him what they'd be worth without me. Worthless shit paper, Lloyd. Ask Lloyd, he'll tell you, he has PTSD from the force of Hurricane Weezy F. Buffett."

"GE, they would've been fine. Then, Fly In came on, so I went in and pretty much looted the cap structure, prefs and warrants and hybrid securities and whatnot. Mostly so that going forward, they now know, this is the carter."

"That's just the killer instinct of an O.G. arb, that's hustler music. It reminds me of my Sanborn Map days. Could I afford to pay $250M in capital gains, of course. But what's the fun in that? I'd rather just launch $4B of stock at Proctor and Gamble and tell them to bring it back without the taxes attached to it. Like tossing a grenade into their capital structure. I really am the scorpion, who stings without knowing why."

"Anyway, I fuck with Weezy, hard, cause he's a blood in the streets, and so that's why he's my go-to when there's blood in the streets."

"Back to Q&A. Our next question is from Lewis Carruthers himself, Whitney Tilson," Buffett says, as the BRK annual resumes...
